stem.en: Now a different made-up farm, growing rice or pulses, where every extra 50 kg of rice always costs exactly 50 kg of pulses. We change farms on purpose: our farmer's sacrifices grow, this farm's stay the same. Its combinations are 0 kg rice with 200 kg pulses, 50 and 150, 100 and 100, 150 and 50, and 200 and 0. Plot all five (rice along the bottom, pulses up the side).

explanation.en: Each combination gives up the same amount it gains: 200−x. Because every 50 kg step costs exactly 50 kg, the curve is a straight line from (0, 200) down to (200, 0). A straight-line PPC means constant opportunity cost — unlike the farmer's bowed curve, this farm's land suits both crops equally well.

hints.en: Start with the two ends: 0 rice means 200 pulses; 200 rice leaves 0 pulses. Then fill in equal steps between them.
